defs.def: to not include sb/sth （用于所言不包括的人或事物前）除 … 之外conjunctionverb

ex.s: It has taken her to every state in the US except Montana, Washington and Oregon, she says proudly.
ex.t: 她自豪地说，这带她走遍了美国除蒙大拿、华盛顿和俄勒冈之外的每一个州。

ex.s: Everyone in the family settled quickly into the city except me.
ex.t: 除了我之外，家里的每个人都很快适应了这个城市。

ex.s: For Parry, the reward is knowing he hopefully made a difference in a child's life, and except for his drawings on bandages, "they can go on and live their lives and never know I was in it,” he said.
ex.t: 对帕里来说，回报在于知道自己或许改变了一个孩子的人生，而且除了他在绷带上的画，他说“他们可以继续生活，永远不知道我曾经在其中”。

ex.s: His teacher ,Thomas Whaley ,is next to him, whispering support.“…Vote for …me …”Except for some stumbles, Chris is doing amazingly well.
ex.t: 他的老师托马斯·惠利在他旁边，轻声鼓励他。"'投……给……我……'"除了一些磕绊，克里斯的表现非常出色。

ex.s: But   53    all this, Hannah still has the   54    life of a Winnipeg schoolgirl, except that she pays regular visits to homeless people.
ex.t: 但尽管如此，汉娜依然过着温尼伯女学生____54____的生活，只是她会定期去看望无家可归的人。

ex.s: Its features are as white as snow, except for some black ones on its face, neck and wings.
ex.t: 它的面貌白如雪，除了脸部、脖子和翅膀上的一些黑色部分。

ex.s: I found that I was the only Chinese doctor among people of all ages, colours and beliefs, from every continent except Antarctica.
ex.t: 我发现我是来自除南极洲以外各大洲、各种年龄、肤色和信仰的人群中唯一的中国医生。

ex.s: I never had anything wrong with my heel except the time the sting ray stung it when I stepped on him when swimming and paralyzed the lower leg and made the unbearable pain.
ex.t: 我的脚后跟从来没出过问题，只有那次游泳时踩到了一条黄貂鱼，它蜇伤了我，让我的小腿瘫痪，带来了难以忍受的疼痛。

ex.s: Anyway, except for that, everything was fine.
ex.t: 总之，除此之外，一切都很好。

ex.s: When I arrived, the building was completely dark except for one light in a window.
ex.t: 我到的时候，整栋楼一片漆黑，只有一扇窗户亮着灯。
